notes: External bytes were hashed at archive time, not uploaded. build/ render work and Python caches are excluded. Original capture CSV and provenance are small preserved sources, not external bulk state.
sequence_hash: inventory_sha256 is SHA-256 over sorted immediate PNG basenames; for each file append UTF-8 basename + NUL + decimal byte length + NUL + lowercase SHA-256 of file bytes + LF. No media bytes are concatenated. This hashes both names and contents; it is not a single-file sha256.
